chat.dndsheets.welcome.dm_key: You're an operator — press P to open the DM Panel. Its Guide button includes DM-specific instructions (DM Wand, dungeons, turns, etc.).
chat.dndsheets.welcome.sheet_key: Press H to open your character sheet. First time here? The sheet's Guide button walks you through everything step by step.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.characters: You can keep several characters. Open /dndchar to switch, create or delete. Each one has its own level, hit points, inventory, spells and resources: switching puts the previous one’s gear away and brings out theirs, nothing is lost.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.level_up: Levelling raises your hit points, proficiency and spell slots on its own. At levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 19 you also choose an Ability Score Improvement: +2 to one or +1 to two. If you close that screen, /dndchar mejora reopens it.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.turn_actions: Your turn can be spent on something other than attacking. With the Turn Actions item: Dodge (attacks against you have disadvantage), Dash (double movement) or Disengage (moving away provokes nothing). With the Help item, right-click an ally to give their next attack advantage.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.cover: Standing behind something counts. A half-height block between you and the shooter gives half cover (+2 AC and Dexterity saves); nearly covered, three-quarters (+5). Nothing to switch on: it is measured against the blocks actually in the way.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.vision: If the DM turns vision rules on (/dndvision), darkness counts: below light level 4 you are blinded, so you attack with disadvantage and are attacked with advantage. Darkvision (dwarf, elf, half-elf, gnome, half-orc, tiefling) sees it as dim light, and holding a torch or lantern counts as bright light.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.hud_states: Top left shows what is happening to you: in red your conditions (paralysed, restrained, frightened...), in amber what you are holding that changes your next roll (concentration, Inspiration die, armed Smite, advantage).
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_bosses: Bestiary bosses play like bosses: adult and ancient dragons, the lich and the tarrasque have Legendary Resistance (3 failed saves a day they choose to pass), legendary actions (they attack at the end of another creature’s turn) and multiattack. Declared in JSON as legendaryResistances, legendaryActions and multiattack.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_encounters: An encounter is a named group of monsters. Build it before the session from the DM Panel (Create content > Encounters) by writing "dndsheets:goblin x4, dndsheets:wolf x2", then drop the whole thing with /dndencounters spawn <id>, or at coordinates if you want it waiting behind the door. They spawn in a ring, and initiative starts by itself on the first hit.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_creatures: Every monster declares a creature type (undead, fiend, beast...). Real rules hang off it: Divine Smite adds a die against undead and fiends, and Hold Person only affects humanoids. A monster with no type is outside those rules, for better and worse.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.class_items: Your DM may hand you a class-resource item (Rage Totem, Second Wind, Bardic Inspiration Horn, Wild Shape token, Metamagic charm, Divine Smite gauntlet, Hunter's Mark arrow, Shield, Counterspell rune...). Right-click it to use that feature.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.death_saves: At 0 HP you roll death saves. 3 successes stabilizes you, 3 failures means death, and a natural 20 wakes you up. A nearby player can also revive you.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.distance: Type /dnddistance followed by a target's name to check the distance to them in feet.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_commands: Quick reference: /dndsheet, /dndweapons, /dndspells, /dndmonsters, /dndpresets, /dndtraits, /dndoptions, /dndturns, /dnddungeon, /dndnotes, /dndguide, /roll (/r), /rollprivate (/rp), /dnddistance. All but /roll, /rollprivate, /dnddistance and /dndguide require operator permission.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_content_pack: Custom weapons, spells, monsters and presets are JSON files placed in <world>/dndsheets/{weapons,spells,monsters,presets}/.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_dungeons_1: Dungeons: build a room, save it with a structure block (SAVE), then right-click it with the DM Wand to capture it as a piece, pre-filled. See DUNGEON_GUIDE.md for the full guide.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_dungeons_2: Configure each jigsaw block with a right-click (sneak+click to copy its config to another), then generate from DM Panel (P) -> Dungeons -> Generate dungeon.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_more_packs: /dndweapons and /dndpresets load custom weapon and class-preset JSON packs; /dndtraits loads and grants passive traits; /dndoptions loads the race/background/class picker lists.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_notes: /dndnotes give <players> hands out a DM Notebook: a renamed Book and Quill. It's private like any book, and Minecraft saves its contents on its own.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_panel: Press P (requires operator permission) to open the DM Panel: turns, spawn NPCs/monsters, grant traits, give items/weapons/spells, adjust a sheet, apply presets, dungeons, and create content — all without commands.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_sheet_admin: /dndsheet adjusts any player's sheet remotely: setslots, restkit, advantage, damagetype, gold, pact, setlevel, setac, setroll, plus the ...item subcommands (rageitem, secondwinditem, smiteitem...) that hand out class-resource items.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_turns: Run combat with /dndturns: start, next, cancel, end, and effect to apply a status effect to a player.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.dm_wand: Right-click a monster with the DM Wand to resolve its attacks and spells, or manage its custom attacks.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.private_rolls: Shift+click a dice button (or use /rollprivate, /rp) for a private roll: only you and any online DM see the result, for things like Stealth or Investigation.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.rest: Right-click a Rest Kit to propose a short or long rest. The rest only happens once everyone accepts.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.rolling: Click the dice buttons on your sheet to roll, or type /roll (or /r) followed by dice notation, e.g. /roll 1d20+5.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.sheet: Press H to open your character sheet. Use the Main, Skills and Attacks tabs at the top to switch pages.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.spells: Open your Grimoire from the sheet to see known spells and slots. Look at a target and cast to use a spell. Shift+click an area-spell staff to preview the blast radius without casting it.
gui.dndsheets.guide.page.turns: In turn mode you get one action and your movement speed on your turn. Your turn ends automatically once you act.
gui.dndsheets.guide.cat.dm.desc: Panel, wands, monsters, dungeons and your own content.
gui.dndsheets.guide.cat.personaje.desc: The sheet, levelling up, resting and dropping to 0.
gui.dndsheets.guide.landing: Everything the mod does, in parts. Start wherever you need to: the categories below hold the same text the old book did, only searchable and easy to come back to.
